notes: Tipped cases stack on tipped cases. A case's wheels are on its own bottom and its wheel cups in its lid, so tipped (a 300 on its end) its wheels point sideways and the wheel-cup rule no longer applies: a tipped 300 goes on a tipped 300, by hand and in Pack the rest. A case standing on its wheels still needs a matching case's cups, and a tipped case's cups no longer count as being on top.
